text: 中金公司公告，此前拟通过换股吸收合并东兴证券、信达证券。本次交易已实施，中金公司新增发行31.04亿股A股，并于2026年10月26日收到证券变更登记证明；其中11.36亿股新增无限售流通股将于2026年10月29日上市，另有19.68亿股为新增限售流通股。
text_en: CICC announced that it had previously planned to absorb and merge Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities through a share swap. The transaction has been implemented. CICC newly issued 3.104 billion A-shares and received the securities change registration certificate on October 26, 2026; of these, 1.136 billion newly added unrestricted tradable shares will be listed on October 29, 2026, while another 1.968 billion are newly added restricted tradable shares.
